page.overview:
What is Jolteon?

Jolteon is a quadrupedal, mammalian, feliform Pokémon with lagomorph traits, covered in spiny bright yellow fur. It has long ears, and a short body shape, resembling a hare or jackrabbit. It has deep purple (almost black) almond-shaped eyes, a blunt cat-like muzzle with a small, black triangular nose. It has a spiky white mane encircling its neck. Its legs and paws are slender, with three toes on each and no visible claws; though it is seen in The Electric Tale of Pikachu manga to have extendable and retractable feline claws. Jolteon has a spiny fringe of fur covering its backside, and a small short spike-like tail that is not often visible (but seen in few games such as Pokémon Stadium and Pokémon Scarlet and Pokémon Violet. Its back legs seem to be powerfully-built, allowing Jolteon to run at high speeds and jump, like a cheetah and a hare, as it resembles both fast animals. In Pokémon TCG art, it is shown to be leaping upward onto a skyscraper, in a similar appearance and manner as a hare/jackrabbit, with its long feet extended. Jolteon is the result of Eevee absorbing the radiation of a Thunder Stone.

A Shiny Jolteon's fur is a bright, neon-shade of chartreuse. The rest of its body is the same colour as its non-Shiny form.

Jolteon are very sensitive and temperamental, which causes them to constantly charge as they quickly change moods. This means novice Pokémon Trainers will find it difficult to tame them, until said Trainers have earned their trust. However, this is not always the case; As seen in the anime, specifically "Eevee & Friends" and Bernice, some Jolteon can be quite friendly or even affectionate like other Eeveelutions.

Jolteon are able to gather negative ions from the atmosphere, using the resulting electricity to create lightning bolts of up to 10,000 volts. Their individual cells also create small electrical charges on their own, which combine with the static electricity caused by their bodies can result in powerful Electric-type attacks. They can also make lightning and cause small thunderstorms.
